items.title: Jack Kelly Interview, 1963-11-17
items.q: So Sheik was just a man that would come in at any time, you know what I mean? He would come and go, you know. But he always was a, you know, a friendly type of guy.

ctx.x: And which he was, you know, but this would go anywhere and for fun. And in those days, we had such things as blue money, they would go to each other's house, you know, and have fun. People didn't work like they were working at the present time, you see. You know? Yeah. And so, we had blue Monday. Like one Monday, you would cook something at your house, we'd go and eat and drink. Mm-hmm. Next Monday, you would come to Miami, and so on. And we'd call them bonkers to some extent. And we'd have fun. Mm-hmm. So Sheik…
Do you remember what Chris called him? Did he call him by his name, or...?
